$description: Time (library wave 4, lane C): a timestamp, a relative time or a date label in the data font, with the focus ring it shows as a tooltip's trigger.

time-font-family.$description: Dates and times are technical values: the data font (DM Mono).

time-focus-outline-color.$description: The focus ring of a time with a tooltip.

time-focus-outline-offset.$description: The focus ring's distance from the text.

time-refresh-interval.$description: How often a relative time and a date label rewrite themselves.
